what_to_do: Open the page in a normal browser (it shows a Cloudflare check to scripts and to the built-in browser). Download the vehicle import statistics for each year 2019 to 2023 (annual file or the December file with the year to date). If SAT offers it, choose the table by inciso (tariff line) with number of vehicles (unidades) and CIF value; keep its Excel format. If the table is by vehicle type, save it as well: build_prices.py then reads it only after a type map row is added to national_type_map.csv.
holds_until_then: Jamaica's average customs value of the same tariff lines (rule 2), or the diesel vehicle of the class times the ATB powertrain ratio (rule 3).

what_to_do: Only if M-GUA-1 gives no unit counts. Open the page in a normal browser and download the tabla de valores imponibles de vehiculos for 2019 to 2024 (PDF). It is a fiscal valuation table (route 3); averaging it needs the registered fleet by make and model, and build_prices.py has no reader for it yet.
rows_waiting: Guatemala classes that M-GUA-1 cannot price.

what_to_do: Open the folder in a normal browser (Cloudflare check). Download Metadatos_BD_IMP.pdf and the import database file of each year 2019 to 2023. Check the metadata for a quantity (unidades, cantidad) field. Save each year as Excel or CSV with the tariff code, quantity and CIF value columns kept.
rows_waiting: The 242 Dominican cells priced from other countries' lines or the ATB ratio, and the 183 cells priced from DGA counts by vehicle type (which would move to tariff lines).
holds_until_then: DGA vehicle-type counts for cars, SUVs and buses (FOB, all fuels); Jamaica's lines (rule 2) or rule 3 for the rest.

what_to_do: Click Solicitud de informacion de estadisticas aduaneras y de comercio exterior. The form asks for personal data, so a person must file it. Ask for: imports 2019 to 2023 by inciso (12 digits) of headings 8702, 8703, 8704 and 8711, with valor CIF in US$ and cantidad (unidades), new and used separated by inciso. Save the reply in Excel.
save_as: CR_DGA_import_units_<year>.xlsx (or one file for 2019_2023 with a year column)
rows_waiting: All 1,200 Costa Rica vehicle cells (40 technologies); the rail cell is out of scope.
holds_until_then: Jamaica's average customs value of the same tariff lines (rule 2) or rule 3, times the ATB ratio of each year.

what_to_do: Open the site in a normal browser (Cloudflare check for scripts). Save the table in Excel.
holds_until_then: Jamaica's average customs value of the same tariff lines (rule 2) or rule 3.

what_to_do: Research Services, Data Request Form (or info@statinja.gov.jm). Ask for annual imports 2019 to 2023 of HS 8702, 8703, 8704 and 8711 at 10 digits, with CIF value in JMD and USD, quantity in units (NUM) and kg. STATIN's own HS query (InternationalMerchandiseTradeTable7.aspx) returns these columns but offers no year after 2014. A fee may apply. Save the reply in Excel.
rows_waiting: The 212 Jamaica cells priced by rule 3 (electric and fuel cell buses and trucks, hybrid trucks), and every Jamaica class through 2022 and 2023 data.
holds_until_then: Jamaica's lines 2019 to 2021 as reported to UN Comtrade; rule 3 where those lines hold too few vehicles.
